title: A Rotor-Dressed Semiton State in a Monopole--Fermion Model
summary: In four-flavor massless QED with a magnetic monopole, a single incident fermion is scattered into a state carrying a half-integral current vector in each flavor channel, called the semiton. Recently, the semiton has been interpreted as a twisted-sector fermion, but its microscopic Hilbert-space representation has not been fully developed. In this Letter, using a bosonized fermion--rotor model, we construct the semiton state explicitly.
